query: Reject on die-cast part. Voids found in X-ray on several cavities. 16/120 pcs NG, lot LOT-DC-2346, DC-03. Vacuum level reading lower than recipe on HMI. Customer complaint, 8D requested.

query: Bore diameter drifting out of tolerance. Diameter measured above upper limit on in-process check. 34/480 pcs NG, lot LOT-CNC-2327, CNC-12. Surface finish also getting rougher. Found at incoming inspection of next process.

query: Length variation morning vs afternoon. Z-axis length varies between start of shift and later parts. 8/200 pcs NG, lot LOT-CNC-2301, CNC-12. Reported by shift 2 leader.
